title: Separate class and trace equations for fixed pullback endpoints
statement: For a condensed coefficient ring R, g:Yprime→Y, a family of R-module lines L, diagrams d,dprime over the two bases, underlying line maps mP,mW and normalized ordinary SourcePullback s, ClassPullbackSquare is the proposition containing exactly the delta equation of PullbackCompatibility. TracePullbackSquares is the proposition containing exactly its traceq, trace1 and trace2 fields, using the endpoints and geometric squares of s. These proposition structures are small wrappers for elaboration of concrete coefficient comparisons; they add no assumptions or data choices.
